data: In the bottom plot, is the green line higher than the red line?

The question asks whether the green line is higher than the red line in the bottom plot. From the analysis of the key visual elements, the green line represents the results for T=0.5, while the red line represents the results for T=1.0. In the bottom plot, the green line is consistently below the red line across all values of Self-CIDEr. Therefore, the green line is not higher than the red line.
